testCase:
F-10: Export only the Paid rows
Goal: Export only the Paid orders as a CSV file.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/f-10/
STEP 2: Choose "Paid" in "Status"
STEP 3: Click "Export CSV"
STEP 4: Verify "Exported 15 rows to orders-paid.csv" is visible
STEP 5: Verify the downloaded file "orders-paid.csv" has 15 data rows below the header and no row with another status

steps.note: Filter orders to Paid and confirm the selected status.
Check the exact visible export confirmation without treating it as proof of file contents.

reasoning: This tests filtering orders to Paid and checking the visible CSV export confirmation. The plan covers the available UI actions and assertion, but the catalog cannot inspect the downloaded file to verify its rows or statuses.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the downloaded file orders-paid.csv has exactly 15 data rows below the header and that every data row has status Paid.
gaps: Verify that the downloaded file orders-paid.csv has exactly 15 data rows below the header and that every data row has status Paid.
